chapters.title: A President on Paper
chapters.intro: You arrive as the president of a country with one garage, one road and a storm that took the Road Beacon down. Mina Wrench is waiting by the bay with a mailbag that has to reach the next town before dark.

say:
You made it.
I'm Mina Wrench.
I keep the garage by
the bay, and I keep
the mail moving.

That storm took the
Road Beacon down.
No beacon, no night
runs, so this bag goes
out now or not at all.

Take it out of town
and bring it back.
Keep the car in one
piece, then we'll talk
about the rest.

objectives.text: Talk to Mina Wrench by the bay in Peach Town.
Carry the mailbag out of Peach Town and back.
Bring Mina word that the road is open.

reward.text: 100 Coins and the garage's first part order

chapters.outro: Mina pins a route sheet to the garage wall. Six towns, six broken signals, and now a president with a car.

chapters.title: Six Signals
chapters.intro: Rex Rivet, a retired champion, keeps the race calendar. He will open it to you once the town's signal mast is lit again.

say:
Name's Rex Rivet.
Used to win things.
Now I keep the
race calendar.

The signal mast went
dark with the storm.
The calendar won't
open without it.

Win a race on the
town course and I'll
put your name on
the season.

objectives.text: Drive on to Fuji City.
Finish a race on the town course for Rex.
Tell Rex the signal is lit.

chapters.outro: The calendar opens. The season has a schedule now, and a name on it that is not yours.

chapters.title: The Static Schedule
chapters.intro: Director Static's championship is on every board in Sandpolis, and Sandpolis is not on it. Mayor Marigold wants the town's records in order before she says so out loud.

say:
Marigold. Mayor.
I keep this council
in one room, mostly
by feeding them.

Static's calendar is
out. Every race on it
is three towns away.
Ours isn't on it.

Help me stack the
records. Then we
argue with numbers
instead of noise.

objectives.text: Drive to Sandpolis and find Mayor Marigold.
Run Marigold's race records to the town offices.
Tell Marigold the town's records are filed.

chapters.outro: Marigold reads the numbers twice, then sends them to every town Static left off the calendar.

chapters.title: The Road Assembly
chapters.intro: Rex wants a public assembly, and Chestnut Canyon is where the crews gather. Foreman Oak signs nobody's name until the work is done.

say:
Oak. Foreman.
This canyon runs on
parts and on
stubbornness.

Assembly's coming.
Every crew wants work
that counts and a
lane to do it in.

Haul what the crews
need. I'll put your
name on the board at
the end of it.

objectives.text: Drive to Chestnut Canyon for the assembly.
Haul parts and signage between the canyon crews.
Tell Oak the crews have what they need.

chapters.outro: Oak nails a fresh sheet to the board. Your name is on it, with the towns you helped beside it.

chapters.title: The Longest Delivery
chapters.intro: A storm warning comes in from the far side of the map. Mushroom Road has one nurse, and the supplies are still sitting in the next town's depot.

say:
Nurse Bell. One of
me, this side of the
storm.

Batteries, medicine,
signal parts. All of
it still in the next
town's depot.

Run it up here.
Careful driving, not
fast driving. I count
what arrives.

objectives.text: Get to Mushroom Road before the storm.
Run medicine and Beacon batteries up to Mushroom Road.
Let Nurse Bell count what arrived.

chapters.outro: Bell sorts the crates by lantern light and says the thing you have been waiting to hear: the road held.

chapters.title: One Road, Many Presidents
chapters.intro: The Beacon is lit and the Accord is written. At White Mountain the towns put one name on the finish board, and it has to be raced for.

say:
Pip. Beacon's lit,
and the Accord wants
one name on the
finish board.

Nobody hands a
presidency out. You
race for it, in front
of everyone.

Qualifier's on the
mountain course.
Give them something
to write down.

objectives.text: Drive to White Mountain for the Assembly.
Find Pip at the White Mountain start line.
Qualify at the White Mountain course.

reward.text: 1000 Coins and a place in the Road Assembly Championship

chapters.outro: The board goes up with every country's name on it. No one owns the road; the next Assembly is already taking entries.

side_quests.title: The Enchanted Forest Archery Rally

vehicle_profile.decals: Soft pink and lavender organic geometry

say:
Ready for our next
road-quest, President?
My arrows -- and tires --
point to adventure!

Three nature charms
are missing: one in
Sandpolis, one on White
Mountain, one along our
Papaya coast.

Find their trail, then
meet me at Lagoon for
a precision rally. Hit
the curves like a
bullseye!

objectives.text: Meet Eva on Papaya Island and hear about the missing nature charms.
Find the Desert Charm trail in Sandpolis.
Find the Snow Mountain Charm trail in White Mountain.
Follow the coastal road to locate the Papaya Island Charm trail.
Return to Eva at Papaya Island with all three charm trails.
Finish the Lagoon Raceway precision rally and post your time.

reward.text: 500 Coins; Eva joins your online crew and advises your Road Assembly campaign.

side_quests.note: Current implementation verifies region visits, Eva dialogue and a Lagoon race finish. It does not spawn physical charm pickups, archery targets, or Eva's custom Miata actor yet.
